sloka: अन्तरिक्ष गतम् देवम् गीर्भिर् अग्र्याभिर् ऐडियन् ।सह संभाषमाणे तु शरभंगेन वासवे ॥३-५-११॥
transliteration: antarikṣa gatam devam gīrbhir agryābhir aiḍiyan ।saha saṁbhāṣamāṇe tu śarabhaṁgena vāsave ॥3-5-11॥

translations.english: While Indra was conversing with Sarabhanga, Rama saw him and said to Lakshmana.
